subject: how to convert time in x-axis

messages.author: 4c1108aaddb5744d
messages.subject: how to convert time in x-axis
parts:
Dear users,

I'm making a figure, x-axis is time,y-axis is daily measurements (e.g. daily temperature). The figure is for one year's measurements. But the data frame just has headers of "year", "day of year", and "measurements". How to convert the 1 to 365 days column to two columns, i.e. "day of month" and "month"? Thanks very much for your help.

messages.author: 9fd7d1050c4a04df
messages.subject: Re: how to convert time in x-axis
parts:
Not sure if there’s a way to do it with ggplot, but you can use strptime. 

x <- 1:365
month <- format(strptime(x, "%j"), "%b")
dayofmonth <- format(strptime(x, "%j"), "%d")


See ?strptime for more info. 

Alison
